This repository contains the materials used for the workshops I am giving at Cascadia R Conference 2026.

# Requirements

Basic experience in Shiny. Understanding what is a shiny ‘module’.

# Pre-Installations:

Basic R/Shiny setup (R, RStudio, Shiny package, etc.)\
Also recommended (but not mandatory): LLM pre-installed in your IDE of preference (free co-pilot via github is ok)

# Topics

- **Shiny modules** - deeper use cases. Demonstrate meta-ui eco-systems such as Pharmaverse/Teal. Participants will plug their own datasets into the framework and leverage built-in features.\
  Will also write compatible Teal modules from scratch, and modify existing modules. <https://github.com/pharmaverse/tealworkshop-shinygathering2024/tree/main/code>

- **Teal** <https://phuse-org.github.io/teal-enhancements/>

- **r2d3** and **JS** integration: Enterprise-ready dashboards: walk-through r2d3 and JS integration for drill-down feature <https://solutions.posit.co/connections/db/best-practices/dashboards/>

- [**Crosstalk**](https://rstudio.github.io/crosstalk/shiny.html)

- **extended UI** or server components: bslib, and others

- <https://github.com/nanxstats/awesome-shiny-extensions>

- **Rhino** framework: <https://appsilon.github.io/rhino/>

- Other: <https://github.com/grabear/awesome-rshiny>

# What to expect:

## **Workshop Format: The Build-Along**

This session is designed for practitioners who want to move past theory and into implementation. We’ve scrapped the slide deck in favor of a **live, documentation-driven workflow** that mirrors how real-world development actually happens.

### **1. Tool Evaluation & Selection**

Instead of a "one size fits all" tutorial, you will identify a specific feature needed for your current project.

- **Compare & Contrast:** We will demonstrate how to evaluate different Shiny extensions and packages that solve similar problems.

- **Strategic Selection:** Learn the criteria for choosing a tool - community support, ease of integration, and performance.

### **2. AI-Accelerated Prototyping**

We will leverage LLMs as a "senior pair programmer" to bridge the gap between an idea and a working demo.

- **On-the-Fly Demos:** Watch (and participate) as we use LLMs to generate boilerplate code and complex UI components in seconds.

- **Rapid Troubleshooting:** See how to use AI to debug integration issues and interpret documentation errors in real-time.

### **3. Live Integration**

Bring your own project, data, or dashboard. The goal is to leave the session with a functional "proof of concept" embedded in your own work.

- **Docs-First Learning:** We will navigate official developer documentation together, ensuring you learn how to find answers long after the workshop ends.

- **Collaborative Building:** Get hands-on help as you experiment with your chosen feature.

### **What You’ll Need**

- **A Project:** An existing dashboard, a dataset, or even just a clear idea of a feature you want to build.

- **Curiosity:** The direction of the workshop is driven by your questions and the tools you choose to explore.
